answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 23454 Country: India Title: I'm an umarried girl and I've been wanting to get married for a long time. Today, I had a dream in which I was getting married ( I don't remember who to ),and a lot of people were coming and congratulating me and i was feeling extremely shy. I've heard seeing oneself getting married in a dream is not a good sign...please interpret my dream for me. i'm very worried. Question: I'm an umarried girl and I've been wanting to get married for a long time. Today, I had a dream in which I was getting married ( I don't remember who to ),and a lot of people were coming and congratulating me and i was feeling extremely shy. I've heard seeing oneself getting married in a dream is not a good sign...please interpret my dream for me. i'm very worried. Answer ID: 23454 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1384/1024/H=1431) It is very blessed dream. The meaning is that Allah will soon provide you pious and good match, in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
